 Driver flees Cobb traffic stop before Atlanta crash
 By Joyce Lupiani FOX 5 Atlanta Cobb County Published  October 23, 2026 7:24 AM EDT Share
 Copy Link 
 Email 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 LinkedIn 
 Reddit 
 Published  October 23, 2026 7:24 AM EDT Multiple crashes, Brookhaven house fire reported overnight 
 Overnight incidents across metro Atlanta included a crash involving several vehicles in Midtown, a deadly wreck that shut down southbound Interstate 85 near Lawrenceville-Suwanee Road for several hours and a fire at a three-story home under construction in Brookhaven. All I-85 lanes have reopened, and no one was injured in the Brookhaven fire.
 The Brief
 A driver in a red Dodge Charger fled a Cobb County police traffic stop Thursday night and entered southbound Interstate 75. 
 Officers ended the pursuit and later found the vehicle had crashed at 14th Street and Techwood Drive in Atlanta. 
 The driver ran from the scene and was not found. The person has been identified, and charges are pending. 
 COBB COUNTY, Ga. - A driver fled a Cobb County police traffic stop Thursday night before crashing in Atlanta and running from the scene, authorities said.
 EDITOR'S NOTE: The above video is from an earlier report.  
 What we know:
 A uniformed officer stopped a red Dodge Charger near Windy Hill Road and Corporate Plaza Parkway at about 11:16 p.m. Oct. 22. The driver initially stopped but accelerated away as the officer approached, traveling at a high rate of speed onto southbound Interstate 75.
 Officers pursued the vehicle but ended the chase after a short time. As they exited I-75 to return to Cobb County, one officer saw that the Charger had crashed at 14th Street and Techwood Drive.
 Atlanta police and Georgia Tech police helped search for the driver, who had ran away, but did not locate the person. The driver has been identified, and charges are pending.
 Atlanta police investigated the collision because it happened in Atlanta. No officers were reported injured.
 The Source
 Information for above story provided by Cobb County Police Department.
